configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Ninja, LLVM, a build tree named after the preset, and a compilation database for the language server. Clang is the default for its diagnostics on template-heavy code, not for speed - on this tree the two compilers trade wins. Point CC/CXX elsewhere for GCC.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Warnings are errors here, which is the bar the pre-release workflow holds.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Address and behaviour sanitizers. The flags go through CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS because there is no sanitizer option to set - a `-D SMASHTABLE_SANITIZE=ON` is silently ignored and builds an uninstrumented tree that reports green. Built with GCC, which is what the pre-release workflow runs both sanitizer legs under.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: The hash table's lock-free slot protocol is the only concurrent code here, and a race in it is invisible to the address sanitizer. Built with GCC, which is what the pre-release workflow runs both sanitizer legs under.
